description:
Open SAM.gov contract notices still taking responses, in one call (no QueryPlan): by
    words (also matched by meaning), NAICS, place, set-aside, agency and notice type, soonest
    deadline first. Each notice has its id (for get_notice), set-aside, deadline with time zone,
    days left, the stated or likely size, a single-bid risk flag and its SAM.gov link; with
    counts by notice type and set-aside. For past awards and money use run_plan.

agency.description: A department, bureau or office, e.g. "Navy", "VA", "Department of Energy".
agency.title: Agency

days.description: Responses due within this many days, 1-365 (default 60).
days.title: Days

naics.description: A NAICS code or industry words, e.g. "561720" or "IT services".
naics.title: Naics

notice_type.description: A notice type, e.g. "Solicitation", "Sources Sought", "Combined Synopsis/Solicitation".
notice_type.title: Notice Type

q.description: Words for the work, e.g. "janitorial" or "cloud migration" (matched by meaning too).
q.title: Q

set_aside.description: A set-aside as people say it, e.g. "SDVOSB", "8(a)", "small business", "HUBZone".
set_aside.title: Set Aside

sort.description: due (soonest deadline first), posted (newest first) or size.
sort.title: Sort

state.description: Place of performance: a state code or name, e.g. "VA" or "Texas".
state.title: State

name: search_notices
title: Search open contract notices
